item.title: Samsung Scraps Memory Development Chief Role to Speed HBM Push
item.description:
Samsung Electronics finalized a personnel and organizational overhaul of its semiconductor DS division, eliminating the memory development chief position so that DRAM, Flash and solution development offices report directly to the memory business head, cutting management layers to accelerate HBM and next-gen products. The reshuffle also upgrades System LSI's sales structure, adds a new logic development team, and replaces heads of the Americas and US production units, all aimed at AI memory demand and US manufacturing.

原文标题：三星电子取消内存开发负责人岗位以加速 HBM 研发

Why it matters：三星半导体核心组织重组直接关系 HBM 与 AI 内存供给节奏，是算力供应链的重要产业动向。

item.title: HIT-Built Fire Rescue Robot Dog Survives 1,000°C in Live Drill
item.description:
A team led by the Harbin Institute of Technology Suzhou Research Institute, together with the Jiangsu Intelligent Robot Technology Innovation Center and other partners, has built China's first fire-reconnaissance robot dog rated for 1,000°C, completing a live drill with the Suzhou fire brigade on November 25. The key advance is not the robot itself but a composite fireproof fabric derived from Long March 5 thermal-protection materials, enabling 10 minutes of continuous operation at 1,000°C and covering roughly 95% of fire scenarios. Laser gated imaging for smoke penetration and redundant 5G links allow stable high-definition video relay inside high-rise buildings.

原文标题：哈工大耐 1000℃ 消防侦察机器狗完成实战测试

Why it matters：航天热防护材料跨界落地消防侦察，给出明确的耐温与作业时长指标，是具身智能在特种场景的实质进展。

item.title: Volvo Deploys Humanoid Robots at Ghent Plant for 2027 Rollout
item.description:

The wheeled, 1.6-meter robot can lift 10 kg, signaling automakers' push beyond fixed robotic arms toward AI-driven flexible automation.

item.title: Terence Tao Shares How to Read Hard Proofs with AI
item.description:
Fields Medalist Terence Tao outlines a methodology for using AI to understand complex mathematical proofs: rather than one-shotting the full proof, ask the AI to strip a general argument down to a simpler one-dimensional case and read that first. He stresses that whiteboard reasoning remains central, with AI best suited to cleanup and to tedious computations whose sign details need not be understood, and notes that knowing when not to use these tools is itself part of the challenge.

原文标题：陶哲轩谈如何用 AI 读懂艰深数学证明

Why it matters：顶级数学家给出可操作的 AI 辅助数学研究工作流，对理解 AI 在形式推理中的真实边界有参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources DFly2 Drafter Model with Up to 4.2x Speedup
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced DFly2, a new drafter model that acts as a sidecar accelerator for Hy4 flash without altering model weights or outputs, delivering up to 4.2x speedup in a single case. Its key design aggressively reuses the target model's KV cache and indexer-selected positions, decoupling attention cost from context length while requiring zero extra KV memory and remaining PD-disaggregation friendly. Weights, full training code and a paper are released together.

原文标题：腾讯混元开源草稿模型 DFly2 实现最高 4.2 倍加速

Why it matters：面向稀疏注意力大模型的投机解码加速组件，附完整训练代码与论文，对推理部署读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Global PC GPU Shipments Fall 5% Year-on-Year in Q3 2026
item.description:
Jon Peddie Research reports global PC GPU shipments reached 72.8 million units in Q3 2026, down 3.6% quarter-on-quarter and 5.0% year-on-year, breaking the usual seasonal growth pattern. Intel gained 2.6 percentage points of share while AMD and Nvidia each slipped about 1.3 points; mobile GPUs fell 9.6% QoQ as the main drag, while desktop GPUs rose 13%.

原文标题：2026Q3 全球 PC GPU 出货 7280 万颗 同比下降 5%

Why it matters：PC GPU 出货量罕见在三季度环比下滑，反映客户端算力需求与换机周期的结构性变化，是观察 AI PC 与终端算力供给的重要先行指标。

item.title: JPMorgan Expects AI Investment-Grade Bond Sales to Hit $450B Next Year
item.description:
JPMorgan expects investment-grade AI bond sales to reach $450B next year, up from $368B this year. The bank sees AI capital spending nearly doubling to $1.4T in 2027 before leveling off, with 151GW of capacity costing about $7T from 2027 to 2031, pushing debt markets toward their limits. Cash-rich hyperscalers are expected to shoulder more of the sector's $2.9T five-year equity need, largely from cash flow.

原文标题：摩根大通预计明年 AI 投资级债券发行达 4500 亿美元

item.title: SenseTime Open-Sources 27B Vision-Language Model for Robot Manipulation
item.description:
SenseTime has released and open-sourced SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B, a vision-language model for robot manipulation, under Apache 2.0. Unlike the Preview version that relied on a VLA model to execute tasks, the official release decides when to invoke the VLA versus directly controlling the arm via code, and adjusts strategies from execution feedback. It scores 34.7 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark, up from 10.0, surpassing the officially tested GPT-6 Astra at only 27B parameters.

原文标题：商汤开源 27B 机器人操作视觉语言模型

Why it matters：开源机器人操作基座模型以 27B 体量在仿真榜单超越 GPT-6 Astra，且引入代码即策略的混合控制范式，值得关注。

item.title: Nvidia Halts Southeast Asia Server Shipments After New US Chip Rule
item.description:
The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licences for advanced AI chip exports to Southeast Asia and Brazil, prompting Nvidia to freeze related server shipments. Chinese AI labs had been renting Nvidia compute from local cloud providers in the region to sidestep direct export bans. Cloud providers now have 90 days to prove no restricted entities are among their users, though compliance mechanics remain undefined, hitting a major revenue line: Nvidia booked $104B through its Singapore unit in 2025, up 72%.

item.title: Sand.ai Unveils 480B Video Model MAGI-2 with Open Weights Planned
item.description:
Chinese startup Sand.ai released MAGI-2, a 480B-parameter video generation model that tops the Artificial Analysis image-to-video leaderboard at roughly one-tenth the price of comparable closed-source flagships. It supports 30-second single-shot generation, parsing of scripts up to 20,000 characters, millisecond-level shot switching, and mixing up to 20 multimodal reference assets, while showing emergent planning ability from pretraining. Sand.ai says it plans to release the model weights soon, giving the open-source video ecosystem a frontier-grade foundation.

原文标题：Sand.ai 发布 480B 视频模型 MAGI-2 并计划开源权重

Why it matters：480B 参数视频模型登顶权威榜单且承诺开放权重，兼具性能、价格与开源生态三重信号。

item.title: SQLite 推出 sqlite3_rsync 支持远程快照复制
item.description:
SQLite 内置的 sqlite3_rsync 工具可在不生成完整本地副本的前提下，通过 SSH 将数据库快照复制到远端，解决了磁盘空间不足时无法备份的痛点。它借鉴 rsync 的分页哈希比对机制，仅传输差异页，同步已有副本时也无需重传全量数据。

Why it matters：为磁盘受限环境提供免全量副本的远程快照方案，对 SQLite 运维与备份实践有直接价值。
